citeproc-js 2.4.63
Copyright (c) 2009-2019 Frank Bennett

citeproc-js implements the Citation Style Language
https://citationstyles.org/

Research Library uses the CPAL-1.0 option offered by citeproc-js. The upstream
source and its original dual-license notice are unchanged. This component is
not relicensed under the Research Library project's MIT license.

2026-09-26 distribution integration: the original citeproc_commonjs.js is copied
byte-for-byte to dist/vendor/citeproc.cjs (runtime) and to
 dist/browser/licenses/citeproc/source.txt (public source download).
No source modifications, compilation or minification are applied to this
component. The application references it as a separate CommonJS module.
The complete CPAL license, including Exhibits A and B, is retained here and in
the browser asset directory. Every Research Library panel displays the required
attribution and links to the locally distributed source and license.

The corresponding upstream revision and license checksum are recorded in
provenance.json, resolved from the published npm 2.4.63 gitHead. Upstream source:
https://github.com/Juris-M/citeproc-js/tree/73bc1b44bc7d54d0bfec4e070fd27f5efe024ff9

Review license and source/attribution requirements before changing this component
or releasing a new distribution. No legal compatibility certification is claimed.
